chunks: Moy otets (da smilostivitsya nad nim Allah) rasskazal nam: Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim rasskazal nam, ot svoego ottsa, ot Ali ibn al-Khakama, ot al-Mufaddala ibn Saliha, ot Jabira, ot Abu Dzhafara (mir yemu).

Kogda byl nizposlan etot ayat—‘I v tot den’ ad budet pribligen’ (89:23)—Poslannika Allaha (da blagoslovit ego Allah i yego semyu) sprosili ob etom. On skazal: Vernyy Dukh soobshchil mne, chto Allah, net boga krome Nego, kogda sobiret pervykh i poslednikh, ad budet privedyon s tysyach’yu povodkov; kazhdyy povodik budut derdzhat’ sto tysyach surovykh i zhestkikh angelov. On budet imet’ grokhotaniye, yarost’ i rev; on zarevet tak, chto, yesli by Allah, Mogushchiy i Velichestvennyy, ne otlozhil ikh do vremeni rascheta, on unichtozhil by vsyo sobraniye. Zatem iz nego vydvinetsa sheya, kotoraya okruzhit vsekh sozdaniy—spravedlivykh sredi nikh i greshnykh. Net ni odnogo raba, kotorogo sotvoril by Allah, Mogushchiy i Velichestvennyy—ni angela, ni proroka—ne voskliknuvshego by: Gospod’ moy! Spasi menya! Spasi menya! No ty, o Prorok Allaha, budesh’ vosklikat’: Moya obshchina! Moya obshchina! Zatem na nego budet polozhen most, tonee ostriya mecha, na kotorom yest’ tri arki: na odnoy—doveriye i rodstvennyye uzy, na drugoy—namaz, na tret’yey—spravedlivost’ Gospoda Mirov, net boga krome Nego. Lyudi budut obyazany pereyti cherez nego. Rodstvennyye uzy i doveriye budut zaderzhat’ ikh; yesli oni spassutsya ot etogo, namaz budet zaderzhat’ ikh; yesli oni spassutsya ot etogo, konechnyy naznachennyy budet u Gospoda Mirov, Mogushchego i Velichestvennogo. Eto znacheniye slov Allaha, Blagoslovennogo i Prevoznessonnogo: ‘Voistinu, tvoy Gospod’ vsegda na strazhe’ (89:14). Lyudi budut na mostu—nekotoryye derzhatsya, odna noga skol’zit, poka drugaya derzhi tsya. Angely budut okruzhat’ ikh, vosklichaya: O Terpelivyy! Prosti i pomiluy! Priyd s Tvoyey shchedrost’yu i daruy bezopasnost’! I lyudi budut padat’ v nego, kak babochki. Kogda kto-to spassutsya po milosediyu Allaha, Mogushchego i Velichestvennogo, on vzglyanet na nego i skazhet: Khvala Allahu, kotoryy spas menya ot tebya posle otchayaniya, Svoyey blagodati’yu i milost’yu. Voistinu, nash Gospod’—Proshchayushchiy, Blagodarnyy (35:34).

ai.seo_question: Chto skazal Prorok o moste nad Adom i yego tryokh arkakh v Den’ Suda?
ai.summary: Abu Dzhafar (mir yemu) peredayet, chto Prorok opisal pugayushchuyu stsenu ada, privodimogo v Den’ Suda s tysyach’yu povodkov, most Sirat s tremya arkami, ispytyvayushchimi doveriye, namaz i bozhestvennuyu spravedlivost’, i yedinstvennoye zastupnichestvo Proroka dlya yego obshchiny.
